text: The authors take prover-verifier games, introduced by Anil et al. (2021) as a game-theoretic framework for verifiable decision making, and formalise a generalisation of them based on the messaging games defined earlier, in a setting where a verifier interacts with one or more provers. They say the generalised definition captures several other protocols (e.g. Irving et al., 2018; Wäldchen et al., 2024) as well as the new protocols they introduce.
title: Hammond et al. generalise Anil et al.'s prover-verifier games to multi-agent messaging games
